column3: MT 41:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “the poor” is rendered “the helpless.”
“All his bed You have changed in his sickness” is rendered “In his illness, You restore him to health.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “me” after “to see.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “saying” to introduce verse 8.
Close to the Hebrew; “a thing of worthlessness” is rendered “A wicked thing.”
“The man of my peace” is rendered “my close friend,” and “has made great the heel” as “Has lifted up his heel.”
